# runpod_machines (Data Source)

All host machines owned by the authenticated account. Deprecated: Machines have no REST v2 route yet; this resource calls the GraphQL API and will be removed when a /v2/machines surface exists.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_machines" "all" {}

output "listed_machines" {
  description = "Ids of the machines currently listed for others to rent."
  value       = [for m in data.runpod_machines.all.machines : m.id if m.listed]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `machines` (Attributes List) One entry per machine. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machines))

<a id="nestedatt--machines"></a>
### Nested Schema for `machines`

Read-Only:

- `data_center_id` (String) Data center the machine belongs to.
- `gpu_total` (Number) Number of GPUs installed.
- `gpu_type_id` (String) GPU type identifier of the GPUs installed in the machine.
- `id` (String) Machine identifier.
- `listed` (Boolean) Whether the machine is listed for others to rent.
- `location` (String) Location or country code the machine sits in.
- `name` (String) Machine name.
- `secure_cloud` (Boolean) Whether the machine runs in secure cloud.
